questions.question: Manjeet singh sold an article for ₹9000 gaining 1/5 of its C.P. Find the gain %.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Manjeet singh sold an article for ₹9000

gaining 1/5 of its C.P.

**Formula used:**

Profit percentage = (profit/ C.P) × 100

**Calculation: **

Let cost price be x

⇒ Profit = (1/5) × x 

⇒ Selling price = Cost price + profit 

⇒ 9000 = x + 1/5 x

⇒ 6/5 x = 9000

⇒ Cost price = Rs. 7500

Profit = 1/5 × 7500 ⇒ Rs.1500 

Profit percentage = (profit/ C.P)× 100

⇒ (1500/7500)× 100

⇒ 20%

**∴ The gain % is 20%.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

Let CP be Rs.1

Profit = 1/5 of CP = Rs.1/5 

Profit % = (profit/ C.P) × 100

Profit % = (1/5)/1 × 100 ⇒ 20%

∴ The gain % is 20%.

questions.question: If the sum of five consecutive even numbers is 40 more than the average of those numbers, then find the middle number of the series?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum of the 5 consecutive even numbers is 40 more than the average of those numbers.

Let us assume that the five consecutive numbers be = A – 4, A – 2, A, A + 2, A + 4

**Calculation:**

⇒ The sum of the numbers = A – 4 + A – 2 + A + A + 2 + A + 4 = 5A ____( 1 )

⇒ The Average of these numbers = Sum/5 = 5A/5 = A ____( 2 )

⇒ As given The sum = 40 + A

⇒ 5A = 40 + A

⇒ 4A = 40

**∴ A = 10 ( A is the middle term of the series )**

questions.question: A cloth was 50 cm broad and 8 cm long. When washed, it was found to have lost 25% of its length and 14% of its breadth. Then the percentage decreased in area is _______
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A cloth was 50 cm broad and 8 cm long.

**Formula used:**

Percentage decreased in area = (reduction area/original area) × 100

**Calculation:**

Length of cloth = 8 cm

Breadth of cloth = 50 cm

Original area of cloths = Length × breadth

⇒ 8 × 50 cm²

⇒ 400 cm²

According to the question,

Length reduced 25% of original length = 8 × (100 – 25)/100

⇒ 6 cm

Breadth reduced 14% of original breadth = 50 × (100 – 14)/100

⇒ 43 cm

new area = 6 × 43 cm²

⇒ 258 cm²

reduction area = 400 – 258

⇒ 142 cm²

Percentage decreased in area = (reduction area/original area)× 100

⇒ (142/400)× 100

⇒ 35.5%

**∴ The percentage decreased in area is 35.5%.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

if length and breadth are reduced x% and y%, find the reduction value/area.

Then,

⇒ – x – y + (x × y)/100

(–) sign represent the reduction.

According to the trick 

⇒ – 25 – 14 + (25 × 14)/100

⇒ – 39 + 3.5

⇒ – 35.5

It means reduction in area, (–) sign represent the reduction.

∴ The percentage decreased in area is 35.5%.

questions.question: Vishal covers a distance of 20 km in 30 min. If he covers half of the distance in 18 min, what should be his speed to cover the remaining distance and completes the whole journey in 30 min.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f568fdf621fa6b9c9ef3f7434186e0d277d6b5416ab7d483f66435fe66617cb.png] 

**Given:**

Vishal covers a distance of 20 km in 30 min

he covers half of the distance in 18 min.

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time.

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Vishal covers a distance of 20 km in 30 min, he covers half of the distance in 18 min.

Remaining distance left to the covered = 20 – 10 ⇒ 10 km

Remaining time = 30 – 18 ⇒ 12 min

Convert minutes into hours = 12 × 1/60 hours ⇒ 12/60 hours

Speed = Distance/Time

Speed = 10/(12/60) ⇒ 50 km/hr

**∴ His speed to cover the remaining distance is 50 km/hr.**

A wins by the margin of 480 votes

A gets 70% of the total votes

According to the question

questions.question: In a mixture of 60 litres, milk and water are in the ratio 2 : 1. Find the quantity of water to be added to make the ratio 4 : 3
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A Given mixture of 60 liters in which milk: water = 2: 1

Let us assume that X liter of water is added

**Calculation:**

⇒ In the Mixture of 60 liter = milk + water = 2 + 1 unit = 3 unit

⇒ 3 unit = 60 liter

⇒ 1 unit = 20 liter

⇒ Milk: Water = 2 × 20: 1 × 20 = 40 : 20

Now as given to make the ratio of Milk: Water = 4 : 3 by adding X liter of water

⇒ 40/(20 + X ) = 4/3

⇒ 40 × 3 = 4 × ( 20 + X )

⇒ 120 = 80 + 4X

⇒ 4X = 40

**∴ X = 10**

questions.question: Om Prakash travels Bombay to Pune at a speed of 80 km/hr and returns back to Bombay by increasing his speed by 50%, then his average speed for the whole journey is _______
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Om Prakash travels Bombay to Pune at a speed of 80 km/hr 

returns back to Bombay by increasing his speed by 50%.

**Formula used:**

If the distance is same then,

Average speed = frac{{2( {s1 × s2} )}}{{s1 + s2}}

**Calculation:**

Om Prakash travels Bombay to Pune at a speed of 80 km/hr

He returns back to Bombay by increasing his speed by 50% = {(100 + 50)/100} × 100

His average speed for the whole journey is = frac{{2( {s1 times s2} )}}{{s1 + s2}}

⇒ frac{{2( {80 times 120} )}}{{80 + 120}} 

⇒ 96 km/hr

**∴ His average speed for the whole journey is 96 km/hr.**

Simple Interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ From the above-given formula

questions.question: The mean of a, b, c, d and e is 36. If the mean of b, d and e is 32, what is the mean of a and c?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The Mean of a, b, c, d, and e = 36. And the Mean of b, d, and e = 32

**Formula Used:**

Mean of a given series = Sum of the given series/Number of numbers in the series

**Calculation:**

⇒ The Sum of the a, b, c, d, e = 36 × 5 = 180 ____( 1 )

⇒ The Sum of the b, d, e = 32×3 = 96 ____( 2 )

⇒ from ( 1 ) & ( 2 ) we get

⇒ The Sum of the a and c = ( 1 ) – ( 2 ) = 180 – 96 = 84

**∴**** The Mean of a, c = 84/2 = 42**

questions.question: Out of 12 terms, the average of first 6 terms is 36 and that of last 6 terms is 42. If the average of first 11 terms is 38, find the 12th term.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of first 6 terms is 36 and last 6 terms is 42,

The average of first 11 terms is 38.

**Calculation:**

The average of first 11 terms = 38.

The sum of first 11 terms = 38 × 11

⇒ 418

The average of first 6 terms = 36

The sum of first 6 terms = 36 × 6

⇒ 216

The average of last 6 terms = 42

The sum of last 6 terms = 42 × 6

⇒ 252

The sum of 12 terms = 216 + 252

⇒ 468

The 12th term = sum of 12 terms – sum of 11 terms 

⇒ 468 – 418

⇒ 50

**∴ The 12th term is 50.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

The 12th term = (the sum of first 6 terms + the sum of last 6 terms) – the sum of first 11 terms

⇒ (216 + 252) – 418

⇒ 50

∴ The 12th term is 50.
